scientific_assessment.unknown_until_repaired: Whether any residual mechanism satisfies the prospective greater-than-0.50 dominance rule, because the frozen specification defines incompatible denominators for estimation and classification.

root_cause: The population.base_aggregation rule defines each category as eligible category count divided by four views per canonical base and then averages across all 48 bases, while prospective_decision_rule.mechanism_dominant requires a category share among eligible parser-valid nonoracle views. When parser-invalid or exact-target views are present, the unconditional four-view prevalence and the conditional eligible-residual share are not equal. The bootstrap denominator-instability rule also presupposes a conditional eligible denominator that base_aggregation never defines. This ambiguity can reverse the frozen 0.50 decision.

smallest_repair.scope: Amend only the estimand, bootstrap computation, and associated regression test; do not change or execute the taxonomy.
required_changes: Freeze the primary arm-by-condition category estimand as sum over resampled canonical bases of n_category(base) divided by sum over those same bases of n_eligible(base), retaining all four views and treating zero-eligible bases as zero contributions to both sums rather than dropping them.

Use paired canonical-base bootstrap resampling with seed 20261013 and 10000 replicates for that conditional estimand. If the total eligible denominator is zero in any required bootstrap draw, classify that arm-condition estimand as INCONCLUSIVE exactly as already specified.

Retain mean over 48 bases of n_category(base)/4 only as a separately labeled unconditional four-view prevalence diagnostic. Also report mean n_eligible(base)/4 as eligible-view coverage. Neither diagnostic may substitute for the primary conditional estimand.
Apply the greater-than-0.50 mechanism-dominance rule only to the sensitivity interval for the primary conditional eligible-residual share in Treatment for both required conditions.

Add one CPU regression fixture containing eligible, parser-invalid, and exact-target views that proves the conditional share differs from unconditional prevalence and that the frozen classifier uses only the conditional share.
